text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Yes,
that's an order for the latest research
materials on post-training care,
as well as books on nutritional management
for light eaters, correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Consider it done.
They'll be delivered to the Trainer's Office
within a week.
...Will you also be attending the upcoming
trainer study workshop?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will send an email with the participation
details
later today,
so please check it when you have a moment.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...It seems you've made up your mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was after school on that same day
that K.S.Miracle and I officially signed
our contract.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
I'm sorry to bring this up out of nowhere.
But there's something I want to ask of you
first.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please let me take full responsibility.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With a body like mine...
other trainers told me time and again
that it might be difficult to even sustain
a racing career safely.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll be dragging you into all kinds of
trouble.
Injuries... or even worse.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If that happens,
you might end up taking the blame.
...I've heard trainers can even lose their
jobs over it.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to burden you like that.
You're giving me your present—
I couldn't bear taking away your future
too.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So please,
let all the responsibility fall on me.
Let everything be my choice, my doing—
choice_data_list: I can't do that, and I won't.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's happening again,
I thought.
Just like the way she's acted all along.
K.S.Miracle is selfless to a fault.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't changed,
and maybe she never can.
If that's the case, then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything else can take a back seat.
Worrying about the future after she's gone,
talk of a "next time"—
I'll cast it all aside right here and now.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes...?
choice_data_list: I'm prepared for you to be my firs...
I'm prepared for you to be my firs...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... You... you can't be serious.
...Trainer...
You're so much more than I ever imagined—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, so much...
kinder than I could have dreamed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with K.S.Miracle's gentle smile,
our three-legged race together began—

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kei-chan! You came to visit again!
You must be swamped now that you have a
Trainer. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
I'm just doing this because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you sweet thing... Ah, by the way,
that recent race!
You won,
right? Your doctor told me all about it!

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
They were raving about how incredibly fast
you were~.
I wish I could've seen it myself!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Once I make my debut,
I'll be running a lot more...
It'd make me really happy if you came to
watch someday.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
is it okay if I play the piano in the
playroom?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
go right ahead!
The kids are always saying how much
they want to hear your playing.
They'll be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I'm entirely self-taught,
so it's nothing fancy, but...
if it brings them some joy,
that's more than enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...
Big Sis plays the piano so pretty...!!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child B
text_block_list.text: Play more! We wanna hear you sing too!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Alright, one more song.
Let's see, what should we do—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. You've got something nice there.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child A
text_block_list.text: This? ...Soap bubbles?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's go with that song, then.
...—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Soap bubbles flying high,
up to the roof they fly..."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Up to the roof they flew,
popped and vanished into the blue..."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wind, oh wind,
please don't blow...
Let the bubbles fly and glow..."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
That's a mountain of research materials.
Just getting back from a study group?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Turns out there's a lot I ne...
Yeah. There's so much I need to le...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're really serious about this,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about trying to scare you off
earlier.
...Hang in there. I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Wind, oh wind, please don't blow..."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Let the bubbles fly and glow..."
